abstract: Recent approaches to simulated and synthetic users offer new ways to support design, but raise questions about how computational representations of users should contribute to design practice. We present NeuroDivSim, an interactive tool that explores simulation as an inspectable mechanism for reflecting on cognitive diversity during design and prototyping. Rather than using an LLM to act as a simulated user, NeuroDivSim uses generative AI to construct inspectable task, interface, and environment models from a usage scenario. After human review, these models are combined with explicit cognitive reference configurations and processed through deterministic simulation. This enables designers to hold a modeled usage situation constant while varying cognitive assumptions and tracing their consequences to interaction steps and rule-based design recommendations. We further report an exploratory pilot evaluation (N=10) that provided formative insights into how participants engaged with the workflow and informed subsequent refinements to the presentation of models, simulation results, and recommendations.

ur.tldr: NeuroDivSim 是一款支持界面设计时反思认知多样性的交互工具。它用生成式 AI 从使用场景构建可审查的任务、界面与环境模型，叠加显式认知参考配置后通过确定性仿真运行，让设计师固定使用情境、调整认知假设并追溯对交互步骤与设计建议的影响。N=10 的探索性试点揭示了参与者与工作流的互动方式，并指导了模型呈现与结果展示的后续优化。

title: NeuroDivSim: An Interactive Tool for Model-Based Reflection on Cognitive Diversity in Interface Design
title_zh: NeuroDivSim：面向界面设计中认知多样性的基于模型反思的交互工具
